gloss: to lure out; to entice out; to coax out

definitions.gloss: to lure out; to entice out; to coax someone into coming out
definitions.explanation: To persuade or trick someone into leaving a place or coming outside. Can range from friendly coaxing to deceptive luring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{誘|さそ}い{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I coaxed my friend into coming outside.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{誘|さそ}い{出|だ}す⟦{作戦|さくせん}→作戦：09673_sakusen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てた→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: They devised a plan to lure the suspect out of the building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}きこもり→引きこもり：10491_hikikomori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{誘|さそ}い{出|だ}すこと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧。
examples.english: I gradually succeeded in coaxing my reclusive son to come outside.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{誘|さそ}う→誘う：01947_sasou⟧ (to invite, to lure) and ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to take out). The nuance ranges from gentle persuasion to deliberate deception depending on context. In crime or mystery contexts, it often means luring someone into a trap.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{誘|さそ}い{出|だ}す: to lure/coax someone outside
- ⟦{巧|たく}み→巧み：07153_takumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{誘|さそ}い{出|だ}す: to skillfully lure out
- ⟦{罠|わな}→罠：13816_wana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{誘|さそ}い{出|だ}す: to lure into a trap

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{誘|さそ}う→誘う：01947_sasou⟧: to invite; to lure — the base verb, broader in meaning
- {おびき{出|だ}す: to lure out — stronger sense of deception, often used in crime contexts
- {連|つ}れ{出|だ}す: to take someone out — more direct physical action, less persuasion involved
